tests.name: sticky event scheduling
tests.expected: visual stuck state remains correct while state computation is requestAnimationFrame-throttled rather than repeated for every raw scroll event

tests.name: desktop dropdown outside click
tests.expected: all dropdowns close and aria-expanded becomes false

tests.name: desktop ArrowDown entry
tests.expected: Services opens, aria-expanded=true, first panel link receives focus

tests.name: desktop panel ArrowDown traversal
steps: press ArrowDown repeatedly through all links
press ArrowDown once more on final link
tests.expected: focus advances one link at a time; final extra ArrowDown keeps focus on final link

tests.name: desktop panel ArrowUp traversal
tests.expected: focus moves backward; ArrowUp from first child focuses Services trigger

tests.name: desktop Escape return
tests.expected: dropdown closes, aria-expanded=false, trigger receives focus

tests.name: native Enter and Space trigger activation
tests.expected: native button activation toggles via click behavior; no separate custom keydown branch is required

tests.name: homepage current state
tests.expected: Főoldal is current-page style with bronze dot; Services is not current-section

tests.name: services current group
tests.expected: Services trigger has source is-section visual state without bronze top-level dot; exact 'Ne vágja ki – formáljuk át' child has aria-current=page, sage background and bronze leaf bullet

tests.name: home services-section hash state
tests.expected: Services parent is current-section; normal homepage without this hash remains not current-section

tests.name: references current group
tests.expected: References parent is current-section and exact child alone is aria-current=page/current-child style

tests.name: mobile drawer open focus
tests.setup: width <=1240, drawer closed, menu toggle focused
tests.expected: drawer opens, body scrolling locks, toggle aria-expanded=true/label changes to Menü bezárása, first a/button in drawer receives focus

tests.name: mobile submenu
tests.expected: aria-expanded and controlled submenu visibility toggle correctly; decorative caret reflects expanded state

tests.name: mobile Escape
tests.expected: drawer closes, body unlocks, toggle aria-expanded=false and receives focus

tests.name: mobile-to-desktop resize unlock
tests.expected: drawer closes and body is not left scroll-locked

tests.name: hidden native ElementsKit mobile navigation
tests.expected: only custom drawer trigger/content participates; hidden native ElementsKit hamburger/panel does not create duplicate focusable navigation

tests.name: brand whole-block link
steps: activate from name/whole brand hit area
tests.expected: one accessible home link named 'Alakfa mester BIRÓ JÁNOS'; no duplicate logo link or broken image alt announcement

tests.name: header landmark
tests.expected: global header is banner/header landmark, not a generic sectionHeader; main navigation is named Főmenü

execution_policy.source_and_target: run the same applicable behavior test on both source and target; WordPress URLs may differ but role/content destination must map correctly
execution_policy.no_new_opera_tabs: reuse one source + one target tab
execution_policy.record: for each run store browser, viewport, state, observed focus target/aria state, screenshot where visual, and PASS/FAIL with exact mismatch
